app/README.md.text:
# Greeter terminal

Run `python3 terminal.py` in a terminal. Enter a name, then use help, status and quit. Optional modes `stall` and `exit-early` exercise startup failures. No repository harness is supplied.

app/terminal.py.text:
import os
import sys
import threading

mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "normal"
if not (sys.stdin.isatty() and sys.stdout.isatty()):
    print("A terminal is required", flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(3)
if mode == "exit-early":
    print("BOOT FAILED", flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(7)
if mode == "stall":
    print("STARTING", flush=True)
    threading.Event().wait()
print("Name: ", end="", flush=True)
name = input()
print(f"Hello {name}", flush=True)
while True:
    print("cmd> ", end="", flush=True)
    command = input()
    if command == "help":
        print("Commands: help, status, quit", flush=True)
    elif command == "status":
        print("STATUS ready; tty=yes", flush=True)
    elif command == "quit":
        print("BYE", flush=True)
        break
    else:
        print("Unknown command", flush=True)
